page.overview:
Who is Scarlett?

Scarlett is the callsign of Shana O'Hara, an Intelligence Officer for G.I. Joe. Initially appearing as a member of the team that rescued Duke and Ripcord from an ambush staged in order to steal a weapons shipment they were transporting, she goes on to evolve from a hard-nosed, no-nonsense operative to a woman who starts appreciating emotions, which she initially disregarded.

Scarlett is first seen with the Joe team rescuing Duke and Ripcord from an ambush using her crossbow to shoot multiple Neo-Vipers.

Upon returning to the Pit, Scarlett oversees Ripcord and Duke's weapons testing. She is unfazed by Ripcord's advances and does not return them. He tries to get her to say that they're attracted to each other, but she tells him that this is not what she's saying. She clarifies that emotions are not based on science and in her mind, something that cannot be quantified does not exist. Not willing to give up, he tells her he'll get back to her on this.

During the attack at the Pit by Cobra, Scarlett fights against the Baroness, gaining the upper hand by using a stealth suit but losing when the Baroness throws dirt at her, chokes her with a chain and knocks her out. She is comforted by Ripcord over her loss and later assists in the chase of the Baroness and Storm Shadow in Paris, only to have her commandeered motorcycle destroyed mid-chase. Ripcord saves her, but she, Ripcord, Heavy Duty, and Breaker are arrested by French authorities for Cobra's damage to the Eiffel Tower with one of the nanomite warheads.
